source.kind: destination envMap / backgroundMap image (not inside the GLB)
source.layout: equirectangular; painted sky in rows 0..~550, below that solid black (hidden by the GLB's mountain backdrop meshes)

runtime.geometry: SphereGeometry(radius 2, widthSegments 32, heightSegments 32), full phi and theta
runtime.material: BackgroundSharpMaterial (frontend/components/_3DExhibit-v2/three/factory/background/materials/sharp.js), BackSide, transparent, fog false, vertexNode sets z = w (drawn at the far plane)
runtime.position: matrixWorld copies the camera position every frame (onBeforeRender), so it is infinitely far
runtime.textureFilter: minFilter LinearFilter (no mipmaps), sampled with raw uv()
runtime.mobile: image resized to 2048 wide via resize() helper (no change, it already is 2048)

directionToUv.note: for a world direction d (unit, from the camera), what texel the dome shows
directionToUv.v_uv: 1 - theta/pi   (uv.y; texture flipY is true so uv.y = 1 is the image's top row)
directionToUv.imagePixel: x = u * 2048, y = theta/pi * 1024 (row 0 = straight up)
directionToUv.verify: derived from three's SphereGeometry vertex formula with scale.z = -1; confirm by sampling a star in a screenshot
